El PDeCAT començar a impulsar l’Espai CiU. Fitxa Roger Montañola com a cap de llista per a les eleccions estatals del 23-J

originalInternalScope.analysis: Title identifies general elections2023; introduction explicitly addresses PDeCAT-EspaiCiU Congress/Senate representatives and Catalan interests. Original cover names Roger Montañola for Barcelona; this does not alone restrict the general programme to Barcelona.

limitations: Programme catalogue and May30 announcement resolved to July26 archive captures, after the election. They are not falsely labelled pre-election captures. July19 homepage and July16 brand announcement provide pre-election territorial/brand evidence; contemporary betevé publication links the identical-byte original mirror.
Original party catalogue separately labels 2021 Parliament and 2019 Junts programmes. Neither supplies23J policy positions. No coalition-member, later conduct or current-domain content is inherited.
Publisher-chain verification is distinct from semantic mapping correctness and complete corpus/release readiness.
